要参加公司的慈善跑步活动，员工必须 --- 一份证明他们同意某些规则的表格。
A. make
B. see
C. find
D. sign

items.question: To participate in the company charity run, employees must --- a form certifying tha they agree to certain rules
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“sign”代入题干后为“To participate in the company charity run, employees must sign a form certifying tha they agree to certain rules”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：D（sign）。
